# Public proof supplements

These supplements complete the notation and written derivations missing from the earlier selected-result delivery. They state ordinary mathematical proofs and preserve every conditional supplier. The paper arguments are not thereby new Lean formalizations. Use each result page together with its linked supplements.

## Foundation and residual services

- [Canonical definitions](CANONICAL-DEFINITIONS.md): recurrence, time boundaries, labels, ghosts, tokens and owner inventories.
- [Ghost tokens and owner transport](GHOST-TOKENS-AND-OWNER-TRANSPORT.md): complete ledgers, incidence matching, dated stock, source graph/forest and immortal limitations.
- [Source time and tightness](SOURCE-TIME-AND-TIGHTNESS.md): E/F context, penultimate capacity, actual death injection, predecessor and fresh-permutation scopes.

## Abstract models and full private history

- [Count-clock implication and abstract boundary](COUNT-CLOCK-AND-ABSTRACT-BOUNDARY.md): scaling-limit proof and explicit 170-residue counterexample.
- [Finite MEX and window models](FINITE-MEX-AND-WINDOW-MODELS.md): zero-MEX owners, periodic rescued queues, graph/window conventions and conditional consumers.
- [Private history and relay resources](PRIVATE-HISTORY-AND-RELAY.md): source packing, corrected exit map, four sources and exact conditional relay/domain accounting.

## Counting and finite certificates

- [Counting service budget](counting-service-budget.md): complete baseline physical-service budget and optimizer.
- [Counting extremizer theorem](counting-extremizer-proof.md): defined deficits, disjoint source-target gain and exact liminf degree-eight result.
- [Finite certificate induction](FINITE-CERTIFICATE-INDUCTION.md): actual legal reply families, periodic proof, lag211 induction and scoped shell criterion.
- [Lag124 proof](lag124-proof.md): complete finite-reduction, context traces and forced-Q argument.
- [Portable finite certificate data](../../certificates/README.md): exact inputs and separate replay scope.

## Pell and block/count coordinates

- [Pell recurrences](PELL-RECURRENCES.md): exact windows, capped contraction, finite rigidity and positive masked response hypotheses.
- [Block ghosts and C50](BLOCK-GHOSTS-AND-C50.md): all block/young/pool definitions and the exact orbit/lineage/absence flux identities.

The [canonical foundation](../../audit/full/CANONICAL-FOUNDATIONS.md), [existing-slope derivation](../../audit/full/paper-b/SLOPE-REPAIR.md), and [strict-liminf derivation](../../audit/full/paper-a/STRICT-LIMINF-DERIVATION.md) retain their own mathematical scopes. An accepted conditional implication does not supply its canonical hypotheses. Open Q=o(n), direct-Q A1 and the original m<=5 assertion remain outside the selected theorem set.
